moments.text: Infrared view looking down at the sea: a tanker ship sits small at the crosshair inside a dark ring; black masking blocks frame the picture.
The screen flashes black and white as the sensor changes setting, then returns zoomed in on the tanker.
Close view of the tanker from above: deck pipes, white tanks and the stern superstructure, with a wake trailing lower left.
The sensor pans down and right off the tanker to open grey sea; a dark circular patch stays around the crosshair.
A small bright dot sits just below the crosshair inside the dark patch; the sensor keeps it there for the next three minutes.
Brief black, white and flat grey flashes as the sensor cycles contrast and zoom; it happens again at 1:13.
A square box reticle appears around the crosshair, grows larger, then snaps back small with a short readout to its right.
The dot drifts away from the box and wanders around it: lower left, then upper right, then lower right.
The dot slides left past the box, drops to the bottom edge of the frame, then climbs back up to the box's upper left.
The box reticle disappears and the north marker jumps to the top; the dot drifts up and left to the upper-left edge.
The view jerks, flashes white and black, then shows a flat grey scene with a dark ring at centre; the dot is gone.
After another flash, the last 12 seconds show a plain grey gradient darkening toward the bottom, with no object.

notes: Official description says 00:00-00:30 'No content', but the footage shows a tanker ship for the first ~30 s. The large dark ring at the crosshair is present throughout (including on the ship) and is not the tracked object; the object is the small bright dot.
